description: Complete reference for all Fallout 4 gameplay systems: SPECIAL stats, full perk chart, combat mechanics, survival mode, V.A.T.S., crafting, settlement building, and companion affinity.

items.title: Fallout 4 — SPECIAL Stats System (Complete)
items.content: SPECIAL = Strength, Perception, Endurance, Charisma, Intelligence, Agility, Luck. Each starts at 1–10 (can be boosted via bobbleheads and 'You're SPECIAL!' book to 11, then perks/gear to higher). Starting stats allocated from a pool at character creation — no stat can exceed 10 at character creation. STRENGTH: Carrying capacity (10 + STR × 10 lbs base), melee damage. S1 Iron Fist (unarmed), S2 Big Leagues (melee weapons), S3 Armorer (craft/upgrade armor), S4 Blacksmith (craft melee), S5 Heavy Gunner, S6 Strong Back (carry weight), S7 Steady Aim, S8 Basher, S9 Rooted, S10 Supersledge. PERCEPTION: Affects VATS hit chance, detect enemies. P1 Pickpocket, P2 Rifleman, P3 Awareness (see enemy stats), P4 Night Person, P5 Demolition Expert, P6 Far Sighted, P7 Sniper, P8 Concentrated Fire, P9 Sand Man (stealth kill damage), P10 Expert Rifleman. ENDURANCE: Hit points (80 + END × 5 + level × 5), radiation resistance. E1 Toughness (damage resist), E2 Lead Belly (less rads from food/water), E3 Lifegiver (+max HP), E4 Chem Resistant, E5 Aquaboy/Aquagirl, E6 Rad Resistant, E7 Adamantium Skeleton (limb damage resist), E8 Cannibal, E9 Ghoulish (radiation heals, high rads recruit ghouls), E10 Solar Powered. CHARISMA: Companion affinity, prices, persuasion. C1 Cap Collector (better prices), C2 Black Widow/Lady Killer (vs opposite sex), C3 Lone Wanderer (bonus without companion), C4 Attack Dog (dog companion perks), C5 Animal Friend, C6 Local Leader (settlement supply lines), C7 Party Boy/Girl (alcohol bonuses), C8 Inspirational (companion damage), C9 Wasteland Whisperer (pacify animals), C10 Adrenaline (bonus after kills). INTELLIGENCE: XP rate, crafting, hacking. I1 V.A.N.S. (marks paths), I2 Medic (Stimpaks more effective), I3 Gun Nut (craft/upgrade guns), I4 Hacker, I5 Scrapper (salvage more from weapons/armor), I6 Science! (high-tech weapon/armor mods), I7 Chemist (chem duration doubled), I8 Robotics Expert (pacify robots), I9 Nuclear Physicist (Fusion Core lasts 25%/100% longer), I10 Nerd Rage (bonuses at low HP). AGILITY: Action Points (60 + AGL × 10), sneak. A1 Gunslinger (pistol damage), A2 Commando (automatic weapon damage), A3 Sneak (detection chance), A4 Mister Sandman, A5 Moving Target (increased dodge in movement), A6 Ninja (sneak attack multiplier), A7 Quick Hands (faster reload), A8 Blitz (melee VATS teleport), A9 Gun Fu (VATS multi-target chaining), A10 Shadow. LUCK: Critical hit chance/damage, random loot. L1 Fortune Finder (find more caps), L2 Scrounger (find more ammo), L3 Bloody Mess (+5% all damage, gore chance), L4 Mysterious Stranger (random VATS ally), L5 Idiot Savant (random XP multiplier), L6 Better Criticals (crit damage+), L7 Critical Banker (store criticals), L8 Four Leaf Clover (VATS fills crit meter), L9 Ricochet (enemies' crits sometimes deflect to others), L10 One Percent. BOBBLEHEADS: 20 bobbleheads (one per SPECIAL plus 13 skill bobbleheads — Barter, Energy Weapons, Explosives, Lock Picking, Medicine, Melee Weapons, Repair, Science, Small Guns, Sneak, Speech, Unarmed, Big Guns) each give +1 to a stat or +25 skill check success. You're SPECIAL book in SS's old home in Sanctuary Hills gives a free +1 to any SPECIAL.
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 SPECIAL and perk system data

items.title: Fallout 4 — V.A.T.S. & Combat Mechanics
items.content: V.A.T.S. (Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System): Slows time to 10% speed (NOT pause — unlike Fallout 3/NV). Consumes Action Points (AP). Shows hit chance percentages per body part. CRITICAL HITS: Critical meter fills as you use V.A.T.S.; when full, pressing the Critical button during a V.A.T.S. attack guarantees a hit and deals bonus damage (2× base by default, 3× with Better Criticals rank 3). Critical Banker perk lets you store up to 3 criticals. Four Leaf Clover gives chance to fill the meter on V.A.T.S. hits. BODY PART TARGETING: Head (critical hit chance higher, can cripple for accuracy penalty), Torso (most HP, least effect), Arms (cripple for weapon drop chance), Legs (cripple to slow/immobilize), Eyes (blinding), Weapon (can destroy ammo/drop). DAMAGE TYPES: Physical (standard bullets), Energy (laser/plasma), Fire (flamer, molotov), Electrical (pulse grenades, lightning), Radiation (gamma gun, nukes), Cryo (cryo grenades, Cryolator), Poison (mirelurk attacks, Bloatfly larva). DAMAGE RESISTANCE vs DAMAGE THRESHOLD: FO4 uses Damage Resistance (DR) as a percentage reduction formula: Damage After DR = Incoming × (1 - DR/(DR + 100)). So 100 DR = 50% reduction, 200 DR = 67%, 1000 DR = 91%. CRITICAL HIT DAMAGE: Automatically crits in stealth (Ninja perk multiplies this). Sandman perk for sleeping targets. EXPLOSIVES: Area of Effect, bypass some DR. Frag grenade (base game), Molotov (fire DoT), Baseball Grenade, Plasma Grenade, Pulse Grenade (EMP, disables robots), Cryo Grenade, Smoke Grenade (concealment), HalluciGen Gas (makes hostiles fight each other), Nuka-Grenade, Bottlecap Mine, Cryogenic Mine, Plasma Mine, Fragmentation Mine. POWER ATTACKS: Melee/unarmed only, hold attack button, costs more AP but bonus damage (varies by weapon type). SNEAKING: Detection meter (hidden → caution → danger → combat). Agility and Sneak perk reduce detection. Distance, terrain, night (Night Person perk), shadows all affect detection. Crouching enters sneak mode.
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 combat system data

items.title: Fallout 4 — Survival Mode (Complete Rules)
items.content: Survival Mode (added in patch 1.5) fundamentally changes Fallout 4 gameplay: NO FAST TRAVEL — must walk everywhere. NO MANUAL SAVES — game autosaves only when you sleep in a bed (owned or unowned; sleeping bags/bedrolls save too). DEATH IS PERMANENT LOAD — die and you lose all progress since last sleep. HUNGER/THIRST/FATIGUE: Must eat food (cooked preferred, raw causes disease), drink water (purified preferred, dirty causes rads+disease), and sleep (fatigue reduces max AP over time). Status icons appear when needs are moderate; red icons mean severe debuffs. DISEASES: Contract diseases from eating raw food, dirty water, taking damage from certain enemies (Feral Ghouls, Bloodbugs, Bloatflies, Radscorpions, etc.), or being too cold/wet. Disease symptoms: Lethargy (AP reduction), Infection (HP reduction over time), Weakness (STR reduction), Rad Worms (radiation resistance reduction), Bloatfly Larva (Bloatflies burst from body on death), Bonebreak (limb damage reduction), Pneumonia (harder to act), Dysentery (constant hunger), etc. Antibiotics cure all diseases (crafted from Antiseptic + Glue). WEIGHT LIMITS: Stimpaks, chems, ammo now all have weight (Stimpak 0.1 lb, 10mm ammo 0.001 lb/round, .50 caliber 0.03 lb/round). AMMO WEIGHT encourages conservative combat. COMBAT CHANGES: Enemies deal significantly more damage. Enemies have more HP. Player damage is unchanged — combat is extremely lethal. STIMPAK RESTRICTION: Stimpaks heal over time rather than instantly. Cannot be used in VATS. COMPANION CHANGES: Downed companions go to a wounded state instead of being incapacitated; if the SS dies while the companion is downed, the companion doesn't revive. FAST TRAVEL ALTERNATIVE: Railroad HQ perma-fast-travel via Railroad agents; Vertibird (if BoS ally); settlement to settlement via supply line roads. VENDOR CARRY: Vendors reset stock every 48 in-game hours. CARRY WEIGHT: More punishing — overencumbered you cannot sprint and take damage over time. BEDS: Owned beds (in settlements you own or beds with no owner) give 'Well Rested' bonus (+10% XP). Sleeping bags give no bonus but do save. RECOMMENDED BUILD: High Endurance and Agility for survival; crafting perks especially useful; Strong Back for carry weight.
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 Survival Mode documentation

items.title: Fallout 4 — Settlement Building & Workshop System
items.content: WORKSHOP MODE: Press E on a Workshop workbench to enter build mode. Can build in any unlocked settlement. RESOURCES: Wood, Steel, Concrete, Rubber, Copper, Ceramic, Cloth, etc. — all from scavenged junk. Junk is automatically broken down into components when used in crafting. SIZE LIMIT: Each settlement has a build size budget (the bar at the top of the build menu); exceeding it prevents saving new objects. Can be manipulated with console commands (removebuildlimitsize) or mods. CATEGORIES: Structures (walls, floors, roofs, doors), Furniture (beds, chairs, tables), Crafting Stations (Workshop, Cooking, Chemistry, Armor/Weapons workbench, Power Armor station), Resources (water pump/purifiers, generators, food crops), Defense (turrets, guard posts, traps), Power (generators, power conduits, switches), Decorations (rugs, paintings, signs), Junk Fences. POWER SYSTEM: Generators produce power (Small Gen: 3, Medium: 5, Large: 10, Fusion Generator: 100). Power is distributed via conduits (no wires needed if you use conduits touching each other — they're 'wireless' within grid). Pylons extend power wirelessly. Objects have power requirements shown in build menu. HAPPINESS: Settlements have Happiness (0-100%). Affects Minutemen radiant quests and gives achievement. Raised by: enough beds (1 per settler), enough food (1 unit per settler), enough water (1 unit per settler), adequate defense (defense rating ≥ sum of food + water), having a Trader (stores raise happiness significantly), having Radio Beacons active. Happiness 100 = 'Benevolent Leader' achievement. DEFENSE: Defense Rating compared to Food+Water = attack frequency. Each Guard Post adds 5 defense when staffed. Turrets add defense passively (small turret: 5, heavy: 15, laser/missile: 12+). SETTLERS: Recruited via Recruitment Beacons (requires power). Max settlers = 10 + Charisma (with Local Leader perk more efficiently). Each settler can be assigned to food, guard duty, crafting stations, or scavenging. SUPPLY LINES: Local Leader rank 1 allows sending settlers as provisioners between settlements, sharing workshop inventories across connected settlements. NOTABLE SETTLEMENTS: Sanctuary Hills (largest buildable area), Spectacle Island (largest island, need to activate beacon), Vault 88 (DLC, underground), Jamaica Plain (downtown area). KEY TIPS: Place all crafting workbenches (weapon, armor, chemistry, cooking) in each settlement. Keep defense at least equal to food+water. Large settlements benefit from heavy turrets rather than guard posts (turrets auto-man).
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 settlement system documentation

items.title: Fallout 4 — All Crafting Systems (Weapons, Armor, Cooking, Chemistry)
items.content: WEAPON CRAFTING (Weapons Workbench): Modify any non-unique weapon. Slots include: Receiver (damage, fire rate, ammo type), Barrel (range, accuracy, handling), Stock (recoil, hipfire), Grip (ADS speed), Sights/Scope (zoom, accuracy), Magazine (ammo capacity, reload speed), Muzzle (suppressor, compensator, bayonet), Misc (special attachments). Requires Gun Nut (for ballistic weapons) and/or Science! (for energy weapons) perks for advanced mods. Full modding of Assault Rifle to 'Powerful .38 Automatic' requires Gun Nut 4, Science! 1. ARMOR CRAFTING (Armor Workbench): Modifiable body pieces. Slots include: Material (DR/ER upgrades — combat, polymer, marine, etc.), Misc (pocketed for carry weight, shadowed for stealth, cushioned for fall damage, etc.), Lining (from ballistic weave — Railroad perk). Requires Armorer perk ranks. POWER ARMOR CRAFTING (Power Armor Station): Full mod slots on each limb + torso + helmet + jetpack. Core frame can accept any generation of armor pieces (T-45, T-51, T-60, X-01 pieces mix-and-match). Fusion Cores power PA. Requires Science! and/or Armorer for top-tier mods. COOKING STATION: Combine raw ingredients into cooked food. Cooked food provides HP and stat bonuses with no disease risk (vs. raw food = disease risk in survival). Gorilla Gummy reduces disease susceptibility. Important recipes: Stimpak (crafted from Antiseptic + Steel + Rubber), Antibiotics (Antiseptic + Glue). CHEMISTRY STATION (Chem Lab): Craft drugs (Jet, Psycho, Buffout, Mentats), explosives (mines, grenades), syringer ammo, stimpaks, antibiotics, RadAway, Rad-X, and Nuka-Cola recipes. JUNK & COMPONENTS: All junk items break down into base components. Key components: Adhesive (from Vegetable Starch craft — most needed), Aluminum (fridge components, aluminum cans), Copper (desk fans, pre-war lamps — critical for power conduits), Crystal (cameras, microscopes), Fiber Optics (cameras, microscopes), Circuitry (hot plates, sensor modules), Gold (cigarette packs), Silver (silver pocket watches). VEGETABLE STARCH TRICK: Cook 3 Corn + 3 Mutfruit + 3 Tato + 1 Purified Water = Vegetable Starch → breaks down into 5 Adhesive each. Best adhesive farming method.
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 crafting system data

items.title: Fallout 4 — All Companions, Affinity & Romance
items.content: COMPANIONS: The SS can have one human/humanoid companion + Dogmeat simultaneously (Lone Wanderer perk works with Dogmeat alone). All companions have an Affinity system (-1000 to +1000) affecting dialogue and unlocking companion quests and perks. COMPANION LIST: (1) DOGMEAT (Dog, no affinity system, always available, unique: can carry items, never judges morality). (2) PIPER WRIGHT (human, Diamond City reporter, affinity: likes helping settlements/poor, dislikes violence/theft; Companion perk: Gift of Gab — 2× XP for speech successes and discovering locations; romance available). (3) NICK VALENTINE (synth detective, affinity: likes helping/unlocking, dislikes excessive violence; Companion perk: Close to Metal — one extra guess in terminal hacking, fewer lockouts; quest: 'Long Time Coming' — kill Eddie Winter; romance NOT available). (4) CODSWORTH (robot butler, Sanctuary Hills, affinity: likes good deeds, dislikes drugs; Companion perk: Robot Sympathy — +10 damage resistance vs robots; romance NOT available). (5) CAIT (Irish cage fighter from Combat Zone, affinity: likes theft, drinking, violence; dislikes good karma/peaceful solutions; Companion perk: Trigger Rush — AP regen faster below 25% HP; quest: 'Benign Intervention' — cure her Psycho addiction; romance available). (6) CURIE (Mr. Handy then synth body, Vault 81, affinity: likes helping/discovery; Companion perk: Combat Medic — heal 100 HP when below 10%; quest: 'Emergent Behavior'; romance available). (7) DANSE (Brotherhood Paladin, Cambridge Police Station, affinity: likes orderly behavior/helping, dislikes chems/stealing; Companion perk: Know Your Enemy — +20% vs ghouls, super mutants, synths; quest: 'Blind Betrayal'; romance available). (8) DEACON (Railroad spy, Old North Church, affinity: likes stealth kills, lying, helping escaping synths; Companion perk: Cloak & Dagger — Stealth Boy +40% duration, sneak attack +20%; romance NOT available). (9) HANCOCK (Ghoul mayor, Goodneighbor, affinity: likes drug use, helping poor/downtrodden; dislikes cruelty; Companion perk: Isodoped — Luck +3 above 250 rads; romance available). (10) MACREADY (mercenary, Combat Zone, affinity: likes helping children, dislikes power-hungry choices; Companion perk: Killshot — 20% hit chance bonus to head shots in VATS; romance available). (11) PRESTON GARVEY (Minutemen leader, Concord, affinity: likes helping settlements; Companion perk: United We Stand — +20% damage and +20 DR when fighting 3+ enemies; romance available). (12) STRONG (super mutant, Trinity Tower, affinity: likes violent/powerful actions; Companion perk: Berserk — +20% melee damage below 25% HP; romance NOT available). (13) X6-88 (Institute Courser, affinity: likes Institute decisions; Companion perk: Shield Harmonics — +20 energy resistance; romance NOT available). (14) ADA (Automatron DLC robot companion, customizable). (15) OLD LONGFELLOW (Far Harbor DLC, hunter). (16) PORTER GAGE (Nuka-World DLC, raider companion). AFFINITY TIPS: Completing companion quests is the fastest way to max affinity. Sleeping with a romanced companion once per day gives 'Lover's Embrace' — +15% XP for a limited time.
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 companion system data

items.title: Fallout 4 — Leveling, XP & Character Progression
items.content: LEVEL CAP: No hard cap (unlike FO3/NV). Can level indefinitely. PERK CHART: 70 base perks × multiple ranks each = 275 total perk ranks. Each level up grants 1 perk point which can be spent on: (a) A new perk rank (requires meeting SPECIAL minimum), or (b) Raising a SPECIAL stat (+1 to any stat). XP SOURCES: Killing enemies, discovering locations (~100 XP each), completing quests (varies), picking locks (5–25 XP), hacking terminals (15–25 XP), crafting (1 XP per item), building settlement objects (1 XP each), reading skill magazines (+25% XP for specific actions for ~30 min). INT BONUS: Each point of Intelligence adds 3% XP gained. At INT 10 you gain 30% more XP from all sources. Idiot Savant (Luck perk): chance for 5× or 3× XP bonus — better at LOW intelligence. Well Rested: +10% XP from sleeping in owned bed. Lover's Embrace: +15% XP after sleeping with romanced companion. LEVEL MILESTONES: Level 4 = first real perk choice beyond rank 1. The main quest scales somewhat but most zones have fixed-level enemies. Level 20–30 = comfortable for most Commonwealth. Level 50+ = can tackle most content. Level 100+ = access to full perk chart. MAGAZINE SYSTEM: 122 magazines scattered across the Commonwealth. Each provides temporary bonus or unlocks unique content: Grognak Comics (melee damage), Guns and Bullets (ballistic weapon crit damage), Massachusetts Surgical Journal (limb damage), Picket Fences (settlement objects), Taboo Tattoos (appearance), Tesla Science (energy weapon crit damage), Tumblers Today (lock picking), Unstoppables (chance to ignore damage), Live & Love (companion bonuses), La Coiffe (appearance), Massachusetts Surgical Journal, Total Hack (robot hacking).
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 leveling and progression data

items.title: Fallout 4 — Power Armor (All Types & Mechanics)
items.content: POWER ARMOR MECHANICS: In FO4, Power Armor is a wearable exoskeleton — the SS gets in/out. Requires Fusion Cores (found in generators, vendors, enemies) that drain with use. At 0% the PA still works but you can't move fast or use VATS AP efficiently. PA frames spawn at fixed locations and are randomly leveled (higher level = better pieces spawned). PA gives massive damage resistance, radiation resistance, and fall damage immunity. PA pieces can be individually removed/added at any Power Armor Station. TYPES (rated by tier/quality): T-45 (lowest tier, earliest model, minimal DR), T-51 (moderate tier, pre-war best power armor, good DR), T-60 (Brotherhood issue, high tier, excellent DR), X-01 (highest vanilla tier, Institute-made, excellent DR+ER). SPAWN LOCATIONS: T-45 — Tenpines Bluff area, Museum of Freedom (first encounter), scattered; T-51 — Atom's Armory (south of Diamond City), Nuka-World (DLC); T-60 — Knights at ArcJet Systems, Boston Airport when BoS arrives, Proctor Teagan vendor; X-01 — Custom House Tower (level 28+), Atom Cats Garage (partial), Government Facility Hub 360 (corner of Mass Ave/Berkeley); Quantum X-01 (Nuka-World DLC, blue glowing). MODS: Jetpack (requires Science 4, allows flight/high jump), Targeting HUD (highlights living targets in red), VATS Matrix Overlay (better VATS hit chance), Tesla Bracers (lightning damage on power attacks), Explosive Vent (AoE on power attack), Grenadier, Sensor Array (better perception), Emergency Protocols (speed boost below 20% HP, torso only), Kinetic Dynamo (AP regen on taking damage), Medic Pump (auto-inject Stimpak when low), Recon Sensors (better enemy tagging). PAINT JOBS: Requires relevant faction rank or quest completion. BoS paint (need BoS ally), Institute paint (need Institute ally), Minutemen paint (Minutemen ally), Railroad paint. FUSION CORE FARMING: ArcJet Systems (5 in generator room), Atom Cats Garage (vendor), The Prydwen vendor, power plant locations. Nuclear Physicist perk ranks 1–3 reduce drain rate dramatically.
items.source: Mossy Team — Fallout 4 power armor system data
